english.note: Use 形容 as the all-purpose verb for putting a feeling, person, or thing into words.
Use this when “picture” means to describe something vividly in words rather than draw it.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 sik1 jing4 jung4 go2 zung2 gam2 gok3

examples.english: They picture the scene very vividly.
examples.traditional: 佢哋將個場面形容得好生動。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 go3 coeng4 min6 jing4 jung4 dak1 hou2 sang1 dung6
